newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Fifteen die as Colombian bus plunges into ravine.
newsitem.headline: Fifteen die as Colombian bus plunges into ravine.

text.p: Fifteen people died and at least 38 were injured in two separate bus crashes in northeastern Colombian on Tuesday, officials reported.

Eight people died and 16 were injured when a bus careened off the highway and plunged into a ravine near the town of Toledo in northeastern Norte de Santander province, close to the border with Venezuela.
The second accident occurred near the town of Codazzi in Cesar province. Seven died and 22 were injured when a long-distance bus plunged into a gully, police said.
